entry_item.definition: (fr. s.); T. gnod sbyin; s. yaksha. Class of demigods, guardians of riches, attendants of the god of wealth ( Bisman = Kubera), sometimes described as evil (cf. T. name). Equals xour øgkygci. ED 442.
Yakcha, malin esprit (Yakschus nomen geniorum , qui Kuvêri, dei divitiarum, sunt ministri eiusque horti divitiarumque custodes).

example.definition: seigneur des Yakchas: épithète de Vadjrapani

entry_item.definition: n. Goblin. A gnome. A spirit of the earth.
